title: Dot Product
text: Generate dot product of two vectors, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Require all inputs to have the same data type}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the output data type, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First operand input signal scalar | vector

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Second operand input signal scalar | vector

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Dot product output signal scalar | vector

params.name: Require all inputs to have the same data type
params.values: Require all inputs to have the same data type on (default) | off

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
